_comment: World Eaters army rule citations (10e). Blood Tithe is the codex-wide resource: each friendly WE death or each enemy unit killed by a WE unit grants 1 BT, spent at the start of any phase on escalating benefits (re-roll Charge / +1 to wound vs target / +1 CP / [LETHAL HITS] for a unit / auto-pass Battle-shock).

simulator.blood_tithe.quoted_text: Each time a WORLD EATERS unit from your army is destroyed, you gain 1 Blood Tithe point. Each time an enemy unit is destroyed by a WORLD EATERS unit from your army, you gain 1 Blood Tithe point. At the start of any phase, you can spend Blood Tithe points to activate one of the following Boons of Khorne. Each can only be activated once per phase. 1: Re-roll a Charge roll. 2: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to Wound rolls for attacks made by your army against one enemy unit of your choice. 3: You gain 1 Command point. 4: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in one WORLD EATERS unit from your army have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. 5: The next Battle-shock test taken for one WORLD EATERS unit from your army this battle is automatically passed.
simulator.blood_tithe.trigger: a WORLD EATERS unit is destroyed, OR an enemy unit is destroyed by a WORLD EATERS unit (1 BT awarded per destroyed unit); spending happens at the start of any phase
simulator.blood_tithe.effect: Army.blood_tithe accumulator. Award hooks fire from _do_shoot / _do_fight / _try_tank_shock / _try_counter_offensive on every UnitKilled — adding 1 BT to the WE army when the victim is WE, and 1 BT to the killer-WE army when the victim is enemy. Spending block in Battle._run_round at the start of the Command phase elects benefits priority-greedy on the WE side: BT>=4 sets army.blood_tithe_lethal_hits_round so Unit.attack effective_lethal_hits = p.lethal_hits or (army.blood_tithe_lethal_hits_round == cur_round and p.faction == 'World Eaters'); BT>=3 spends 3 for +1 CP (cap 6). Auto-pass Battle-shock (5) and +1-to-wound-vs-target (2) are tracked as TODOs — the 4-BT Lethal Hits is the most impactful and the 3-BT CP gain is the next cleanest spend; the 1-BT re-roll-a-charge is skipped because the simulator's charge roll doesn't currently expose a re-roll hook, and 5-BT Battle-shock auto-pass is a rare per-battle effect.
